Hello! My name is Yacine. I am twelve years old and I am Algerian. My best friend is Lina. She is from Tunisia. She has got long black hair and brown eyes. Her father is a doctor and her mother is a teacher. We are in the same class. We are very good friends!

(Text written by the site)

A. Reading comprehension (8 points)

1. Answer: a) How old is Yacine? b) Where is Lina from? c) What is Lina's father's job?

2. True or false? a) Lina has got short hair. b) Yacine and Lina are in the same class.

B. Mastery of language (6 points)

1. Complete with "am / is / are": I ...... a pupil. — She ...... Tunisian. — We ...... friends.

2. Complete with "my / his / her": Yacine: "...... name is Yacine." — Lina has a brother. ...... name is Sami.
